name: Lipstick
overview: Scripture warns against adopting appearances that blur the distinctions God has established, as seen in Deuteronomy 22:5 which forbids women from wearing men's garments and vice versa, emphasizing holiness and order. Jeremiah 4:30 critiques superficial beautification like painting the face, highlighting that external adornments cannot secure true honor or favor. Instead, Proverbs 31:25 points believers toward clothing themselves in strength and honor, reflecting inner godliness rather than outward decoration. Christians are called in Romans 12:2 to be transformed by renewing the mind rather than conforming to worldly standards, aligning their identity with God's perfect will rather than transient external appearances.
